nl.title: WordPress multisite in DirectAdmin
nl.excerpt: WordPress multisite op DirectAdmin: subdomains/subdirs, DNS wildcards en Installatron-keuzes.
nl.bodyHtml:
Multisite deelt één WP-core voor meerdere sites — planning van URL-modus en DNS is cruciaal.

Voorbereiding

  • Lege installatie of bewuste conversie
  • DNS-wildcard bij subdomains

Stappen

  1. Bepaal subdomains vs. subdirectories
  2. Installeer WP (Installatron) op root
  3. Volg WP Netwerk-setup / of Installatron multisite-optie
  4. Zet wildcard DNS bij subdomain-modus
  5. Configureer SSL (wildcard of per host)

Controleren

  • Tweede site bereikbaar
  • Supersite admin werkt

Tip: Multisite is complexer in backups/restore — documenteer.

Let op: Shared hosting limieten kunnen netwerken beperken.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

Gerelateerd: subdomain; letsencrypt-da.

en.title: WordPress multisite in DirectAdmin
en.excerpt: WordPress multisite in DirectAdmin: backup, wp-admin, clear cache, verify.
en.bodyHtml:
For “WordPress multisite in DirectAdmin” you work in WordPress (/wp-admin) on TripleZero iT hosting. Take a backup first; then change carefully and clear caches.

Preparation

  • Installatron or panel backup (files + database)
  • Login to /wp-admin of the correct site
  • DirectAdmin File Manager if wp-admin will not open

Steps

  1. Create a backup via Installatron or DirectAdmin.
  2. Sign in to /wp-admin.
  3. Apply the change in the menu that matches the topic (Plugins, Themes, Settings, Users, Media or WooCommerce).
  4. Save. On a critical error: via File Manager temporarily rename wp-content/plugins or activate a default theme.
  5. Clear page cache, object cache and CDN cache.
  6. Test the homepage, login and a critical flow (form or checkout).

Verify

  • No critical error
  • Change visible on the front end or in wp-admin

Tip: Change one plugin or theme at a time — faster rollback.

Note: Do not delete the uploads folder or database tables without a restore plan.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: Installatron backup, PHP version, critical error.
